body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> HP presented its digital camcorder HP 'V506h' during Showstoppers at CES 2010, featuring dual SD car slot, 3" wide touch screen, motion detection and up to 12MP still image capture.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
